audit: M5.32 R24-0 adversarial audit of the form-level claims C1 to C6
verdict_convention: PASS or FAIL against the claim line of each check; FAIL = refuted or not reproduced; kind scope = an extension beyond the stated conditions of a claim

C1.v4_closed_form.claim: V4 on the split equals 4 eps^4 (1 + 9 d^2 + 36 d^4 + 12 d^2 eps^2 + eps^4), symbolically

C1.v3_closed_form.claim: the p <= 3 member equals 4 eps^4 (1 + 9 d^2), symbolically

C1.no_eps2_term.claim: the lowest power of eps in V4 on the split is 4

C1.numeric_matrix_traces.claim: the closed form matches V4 from matrix-power traces at three random eps (rel < 1e-6)

C2.ode_residual.claim: sqrt(r) K_nu(sqrt(beta) r^2 / 2) solves eps'' = (A / r^2 + beta r^2) eps (rel < 1e-12)

C2.rho_nu_K_nu_collapse.claim: eps r^(2 nu - 1/2) / (rho^nu K_nu) is one constant over r 6 to 18 (spread < 1e-10)
C2.rho_nu_K_nu_collapse.note: an identity once C2.ode_residual holds; the ODE checks carry the test

C2.backward_integration.claim: a backward integration from r = 40 lands on the closed form at r 30, 18, 12, 6

C2.off_by_31_to_39_percent.claim: the form sqrt(rho) K_nu is off by 31 to 39 percent over the window r 6 to 18
C2.off_by_31_to_39_percent.note: not reproduced: A = 1 gives max / min - 1 = 13.8 percent, A = 3 gives 141.6 percent, and no normalization of the deviation range gives 31 to 39; only the window r 6 to 18 was tested

C3a.vacuum_orbit.claim: the Riesz B vanishes on 400 random Lorentz images of the vacuum (|B| / |N| < 1e-8)

C3d.euclidean_not_invariant.claim: the Euclidean construction gives B != 0 on boosted vacua (median |B| > 1e-3) and B = 0 on rotated ones (< 1e-10)
C3d.euclidean_not_invariant.note: a boost along a doublet axis leaves the Euclidean B at zero: see the extras

C3b.trB2_on_split_orbit.claim: tr B^2 = 2 eps^2 on 400 random Lorentz images of the split, |eps| < 0.25 (rel < 1e-5)

C3b.ordering_swap.claim: tr B^2 = 2 eps^2 persists at eps = 0.9, where delta + eps passes the eigenvalue 1
C3b.ordering_swap.note: the 'largest spacelike eigenvalue' selection rule picks the wrong member once delta + eps > 1; the cluster read is valid for delta + |eps| < 1 only

C3c.smooth_through_coalescence.claim: B(t) is smooth across the coalescence on a generic line (even part falls linearly in t, degree-5 fit residual < 1e-2 of scale) while a single projector jumps by O(1)

C4.covariant_trace_named_cases.claim: tr(dB dB) = -2 |B a|^2 theta'^2 on the five named cases (rel < 1e-5; zero off the doublet plane)

C4.covariant_trace_sweep.claim: the same closed form on 300 random (a, eps, theta) with the background at rest (rel < 1e-4), never positive

C4.h_metric_sweep.claim: the h-metric contraction equals +2 |B a|^2 theta'^2 on the same sweep (rel < 1e-4)

C4.frobenius_finite_theta.claim: the Frobenius contraction equals +2 |B a|^2 theta'^2 at finite theta (rel < 1e-4)
C4.frobenius_finite_theta.note: refuted at finite theta: the Frobenius contraction is frame dependent and grows as cosh(4 theta) (extras, EX.c4e); it equals the claim at theta = 0 only

C4.generic_frame_background.claim: the closed form, with B of the background, holds when the split background sits in a random global Lorentz frame
C4.generic_frame_background.note: with a boosted background the lab-frame boost generator is a boost plus a rotation in the rest frame, and the rotation part contributes with the other sign

C6a.no_linear_term_on_doublet.claim: the first variation vanishes on all 8 doublet jets at 8 random points (scaled, < 1e-10)

C6.fd_self_check.claim: own (linear, Hessian) pair matches five-point stencils of the full quartic density (rel < 1e-8)

C6b.table_as_quadratic_form.claim: the listed table t gives the second variation as e2 = v^T t v, that is d2e / dv dv = 2 t, on the doublet block (rel < 1e-10)

C6b.table_as_hessian_entries.claim: the listed table equals the Hessian entries d2e / dv dv as labeled (rel < 1e-10)
C6b.table_as_hessian_entries.note: a uniform factor 2 on every entry, a labeling convention: the table holds the coefficients of the quadratic form, not second derivatives; the angular eigenvalue is a ratio inside the table and does not move

C6.mixed_blocks_nonzero_pointwise.claim: the doublet x director and the doublet x massive blocks are nonzero pointwise, so any decoupling has to come from the angular integration or the constraint

C6c.doublet_lowest_48_L2.claim: the lowest angular eigenvalue of the doublet sector is 48 (A = 3), multiplicity 10 = 2 x 5

C6c.doublet_ladder_L2.claim: the doublet ladder starts 48, 96, 160 = 8 (l (l + 1) - 4) + 32 for l = 2, 3, 4

C6.radial_tangential_block_vanishes_L2.claim: the radial x tangential block C vanishes on the doublet (|C| / |K| < 1e-10), so power laws separate and A = p (p - 1)

C6iii.coupled_48_survives_L2.claim: with the constrained director coupled in, the eigenvalue 48 keeps multiplicity 10 and doublet weight 1 (> 0.999)
C6iii.coupled_48_survives_L2.note: the modes below 48 (A = 0 and A = 2) are pure director modes, doublet weight 0

C6iii.doublet_director_block_integrates_.claim: the doublet x director block is nonzero pointwise and integrates to zero over the sphere (< 1e-9)

C6.doublet_massive_block_L2.claim: the doublet decouples from the massive rr and tt sectors in the curvature term (integrated K block < 1e-9)
C6.doublet_massive_block_L2.note: the integrated doublet x massive block is of the size of K itself; the massive modes carry a potential mass, and the Schur check sizes the effect

C6c.doublet_lowest_48_L3.claim: the lowest angular eigenvalue of the doublet sector is 48 (A = 3), multiplicity 10 = 2 x 5

C6c.doublet_ladder_L3.claim: the doublet ladder starts 48, 96, 160 = 8 (l (l + 1) - 4) + 32 for l = 2, 3, 4

C6.radial_tangential_block_vanishes_L3.claim: the radial x tangential block C vanishes on the doublet (|C| / |K| < 1e-10), so power laws separate and A = p (p - 1)

C6iii.coupled_48_survives_L3.claim: with the constrained director coupled in, the eigenvalue 48 keeps multiplicity 10 and doublet weight 1 (> 0.999)
C6iii.coupled_48_survives_L3.note: the modes below 48 (A = 0 and A = 2) are pure director modes, doublet weight 0

C6iii.doublet_director_block_integrates_.claim: the doublet x director block is nonzero pointwise and integrates to zero over the sphere (< 1e-9)

C6.doublet_massive_block_L3.claim: the doublet decouples from the massive rr and tt sectors in the curvature term (integrated K block < 1e-9)
C6.doublet_massive_block_L3.note: the integrated doublet x massive block is of the size of K itself; the massive modes carry a potential mass, and the Schur check sizes the effect

C6m.A3_asymptotic.claim: with the massive modes eliminated adiabatically, the lowest doublet-like A returns to 3 at large r (r = 1000, rel < 1e-3)

C6m.A3_outer_window.claim: A_eff stays within 5 percent of 3 at r = 12 and r = 18

C6m.A3_inner_window.claim: A_eff stays within 5 percent of 3 at r = 6 and r = 9
C6m.A3_inner_window.note: an adiabatic estimate, not a solved radial problem: the coupling to the massive modes pulls A_eff below 3 inside r of about 10, where the mode is also only partly doublet (weight 0.55 at r = 6)

C6fd.doublet_block_vs_pointwise.claim: a brute-force second variation on the exact nonlinear family reproduces the pointwise doublet Hessian (abs < 1e-4 on a scale of 40)

C6fd.doublet_block_vs_2x_table.claim: the same brute-force Hessian equals 2 x the listed table (abs < 1e-4)

C6fd.director_constraint_term.claim: freezing the eigenvalues (unit n) adds -96 to the (d1, d1) and (d2, d2) Hessian entries and nothing else (abs < 1e-2): the -48 of the Galerkin director block

C6fd.mixed_block_divergence_form.claim: the constraint correction of the doublet x director block has the divergence form (abs < 1e-2 on a correction of size 16 to 22)

C6fd.constrained_mixed_block_vanishes.claim: on the constrained family the doublet x director block vanishes pointwise (abs < 1e-2), and no linear term survives on the doublet jets

EX.c3d_single_boosts.claim: on single boosts at rapidity 0.5 the Riesz B vanishes (< 1e-10) for every axis, and the Euclidean B is nonzero exactly when the boost has a component along e1

EX.c4d_rotated_background.claim: the closed form holds on a spatially rotated split background (rel < 1e-4, never positive)

EX.c4d_boosted_background.claim: tr(dB dB) stays negative on a lab-frame boost ripple when the split background is itself boosted (rapidity 0.1, 0.5, 1.0)
EX.c4d_boosted_background.note: the sign is a statement about boosts in the rest frame of the background; a lab-frame boost of a moving background carries a rotation part of the other sign

EX.c4e_frobenius_equals_claim.claim: Frobenius / (2 |B a|^2 theta'^2) = 1 for theta up to 1 (rel < 1e-4)
EX.c4e_frobenius_equals_claim.note: refuted at finite theta: the ratio is 1.0032 at theta 0.02, 3.76 at 0.5, 27.3 at 1.0; the claim holds at theta = 0 only

EX.c4e_cosh_law.claim: the Frobenius ratio follows cosh(4 theta) while the h-metric ratio stays +1 and the covariant ratio stays -1 (rel < 1e-5)

EX.c2_candidate_readings.claim: some normalization of sqrt(rho) K_nu against r^(2 nu) K_nu reproduces 'off by 31 to 39 percent' on r 6 to 18 (both ends within 3 points)
EX.c2_candidate_readings.note: not reproduced: the closest reading, the (2 / sqrt beta)^(1/2) normalization, gives 24 to 41 percent; supplements C2.off_by_31_to_39_percent

C5.baseline_energy.claim: own lattice energy equals the production energy on the stored field, and both equal the claimed E0 (rel < 1e-9)

C5.claimed_cases.claim: the three claimed dE reproduce with the production energy (rel < 1e-8)

C5.own_energy_agrees.claim: own energy gives the same dE as the production energy on all 33 rows (rel < 1e-6)

C5.negative_on_every_row.claim: dE < 0 on all 33 (A, k) rows, with the symmetry of M kept (asymmetry < 1e-12)

C5.curvature_term_alone.claim: the change sits in the curvature term: V4 and the linear member move by < 1e-10

C5.quadratic_in_A.claim: dE / A^2 is one constant at small A for every k (A = 1e-3 against 1e-4, rel < 1e-3): a second-order instability, not a finite-amplitude effect

C5.second_order_prediction.claim: own small-theta second-order form on the lattice stencil predicts dE at A = 1e-4 (rel < 2e-2)

C5.uniform_boost_invariance.claim: a uniform boost of the whole field leaves the production energy unchanged (< 1e-9)

C5.rotation_ripple_control.claim: a rotation ripple of the same shape raises the energy (the field is a minimum against rotations)

C5.axis_envelope_shell_variants.claim: dE stays negative for the boost along x and z, for a k = 0 bump at three widths and for shell-confined ripples at r = 6, 12, 16

C5.uniform_background_control.claim: on a uniform vacuum, where the continuum form gives zero, the lattice residue is below 1e-3 of the field's dE for the same ripple

VA.scales_as_A6.claim: the ripple energy on the uniform vacuum is a lattice artifact of order A^6 (dE / A^6 constant to 1 percent between A = 0.02 and 0.01), so it cannot feed an A^2 signal

VA.negligible_against_c5.claim: at A = 0.05, k h / pi = 1/2 the artifact is below 1e-3 of the claimed C5 dE

VA.matches_production_energy.claim: own curvature energy and the production energy agree on the vacuum artifact (rel < 1e-6)
